ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Forsaken Crags
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
FORSAKENCRAGS_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 6 of the biome-mod-architecture split). A drowned-in-darkness, obsidian-black highland biome and its own worldgen placement, fully generalized: it names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet. A separate frozen campaign world's own Forsaken Crags instance is unaffected and unrelated; this is a new sibling biome for everyone else's worlds, not a rename of that one.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it.
Ships the biome and its own placement worker (RM_BiomeWorker_ForsakenCrags), the donor-content roster (Alpha Biomes' terrain/weather, Alpha Animals' fauna, Alpha Biomes/Alpha Genetics flora) transplanted wholesale from the frozen campaign twin, and a Mod Settings screen with the standard worldgen-rarity master toggle (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine — defaults = shipped behavior, 0 = never generates). No mechanics kit exists for this biome yet (the Unveiling weather, darkbeast Dark-halo behaviour, gust-wind variability are all unbuilt and land here later, at any point, with no dependency direction).
⚠️ Unlike most RimMandrake biome mods, this one is NOT donor-free: its terrain, texture and eight wildPlants entries name Alpha Biomes/Alpha Genetics defs with no MayRequire guard, inherited unchanged from the frozen campaign twin (the twin's own donor roster was ruled "wholesale" by its design sheet, and no fix to that gap was in this build's scope). Alpha Biomes and Alpha Genetics are therefore genuinely required for full function; the fourteen wildAnimals entries are individually MayRequire'd on Alpha Animals and degrade gracefully without it.
NOT in this mod: the Star Wars-tier predators (Cindermare, Skarnix) that hunt here in the campaign — those ride a Utinni patch onto this mod's own RM_ForsakenCrags def rather than living inside it, per the Q11a naming-tier ruling. The Forsakens (the campaign's mystery race) and the six Forsaken vaults are campaign plot content and stay in Utinni entirely.
